summary: End-to-end tested the new 'Design Your Escape' CTA + lead-capture modal on all 4 itinerary detail pages (Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Egypt, Thailand). Verified: (a) visible eg-detail-price-cta label is exactly 'Design Your Escape' with eg-btn-filled class on all 4 pages; (b) click opens dye-modal without URL change and without scroll jump; (c) heading 'Design Your Escape' + supporting text present; dye-destination is readOnly with values Sri Lanka / Vietnam / Egypt / Thailand respectively; placeholders 'Enter your name' / 'Enter your phone number' / 'Enter your email address'; submit label 'Start Planning'. Validation: empty submit -> 3 dye-error messages (name/phone/email); phone 'abc' + email 'foo' -> 'valid phone'/'valid email' inline errors, no browser alert; errors clear when typing. Submit valid data on Sri Lanka: POST /api/leads returned 200 with destination 'Sri Lanka', trip_title starting 'Emerald Isle Explorer...', source 'design-your-escape'; success screen shows 'Thank you, QA!' and 'Back to itinerary' closes modal. GET /api/leads confirms the lead is persisted with destination 'Sri Lanka'. Close behaviours: X (dye-close), overlay click (outside card), Escape key all close the modal; body overflow restored (scrolling works). Sticky eg-sticky-cta after scrolling reads 'Design Your Escape' and opens the same modal with same destination. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390) before AND with modal open; dye-card width == 390; close/submit/inputs all visible & tappable; mobile eg-detail-price-cta opens the modal. Regression: Sri Lanka detail page still shows price 'From ₹94,472'; no page/JS errors during flow (only unrelated 3rd-party 401 warnings, Cloudflare Turnstile & Vimeo).
critical_code_review_comments: DesignEscapeModal wires the overlay as a <button> with aria-label='Close'; the card is a sibling with position:relative so a click at the geometric center of the overlay is intercepted by the card. Closing via overlay only works when the user clicks the visible backdrop area. Behaviour is correct, but consider an onMouseDown on the outer wrapper to make overlay-close more robust across viewports.

destinationFor() infers destination via substring match on title/slug/route cities; if a future itinerary title omits the destination name it will fall back to 'Egypt'. Consider an explicit destination field on the detail data object.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 1 real lead via UI: QA Tester / qa@example.com / 9876543210 / Sri Lanka / trip_title='Emerald Isle Explorer...' / source='design-your-escape' (id 3461c778-1b77-4d6a-b014-2d89daf4ec66).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature fully working end-to-end across all 4 destinations. data-testids used: eg-detail-price-cta (2 instances, use visible one - mobile card hidden on desktop and vice versa), eg-sticky-cta (appears after ~500px scroll), dye-modal/dye-overlay/dye-card/dye-close/dye-name/dye-phone/dye-email/dye-destination/dye-submit/dye-error/dye-success/dye-done. For overlay-close via Playwright, click at screen edge (e.g. page.mouse.click(50,50)) not the overlay's center (card intercepts). POST /api/leads body shape: {name, phone, email, destination, trip_title, source}.
